# FearDev

> A fast, lightweight, and 100% privacy-focused utility toolkit for developers, freelancers, and content creators with instant client-side processing and zero server uploads.

## Tools

- [Text Case Converter](/tools/case-converter): Transform strings and code identifiers between UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, and kebab-case with live character and word metrics.
- [Image to Text (OCR)](/tools/image-to-text): Extract editable text and code snippets from images, screenshots, and scanned documents in the browser using client-side WebAssembly OCR.
- [Fiverr/Upwork Word Checker](/tools/fiverr-word-checker): Scan client communications and proposals against Fiverr and Upwork Terms of Service (TOS) restricted keywords to prevent warnings and account suspensions.
- [Image Format Converter](/tools/image-format-converter): Convert images between JPEG, PNG, and WEBP formats directly in the browser with adjustable quality compression and instant downloads.

## Optional

- [Homepage](/): Main dashboard and feature highlights.
